reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User input from request.getParameterMap() flows through bar -> input.getBytes() -> encryption -> decodeForHTML() -> response.getWriter(). While encryption obscures the exact payload, user-controlled data reaches the HTML response sink. Alert 2 (java/stack-trace-exposure L99): alert-TP — e.printStackTrace(response.getWriter()) exposes full stack trace to client. Alert 3 (java/stack-trace-exposure L105): alert-TP — Same pattern at second exception handler. All three alerts represent real vulnerabilities.
